name: SaaS App & Dashboard Redesign
goal: Upgrade dense product UI, tokens, states, and component responsiveness without marketing fluff.
conflictNote: Enforces Operate mode: quiet elevation, <=200ms transitions, single accent, zero decorative gradients.

name: Marketing & Landing Page Craft
goal: Create a distinctive high-conversion landing page that avoids generic AI card grids and eyebrows.
conflictNote: Unlocks Persuade mode for expressive typography and one hero moment while enforcing strict compositor-only motion.

name: 60fps Motion & Interaction Polish
goal: Remove animation jank, fix curves/timing, and add tactile press and popover origin details.
conflictNote: Frequency-gated: 100+/day actions stay un-animated; exits stay shorter than entrances; prefers-reduced-motion mandatory.

name: Multi-Viewport & WCAG 2.2 AA Audit
goal: Eliminate sideways overflow, hover-only touch traps, 200% zoom clipping, and keyboard/ARIA failures.
conflictNote: Component layouts use @container queries; viewport media queries govern only page shells and global typography.

name: Full-Stack API, DB & Security Ship
goal: Design contract-first APIs, schema constraints, auth boundaries, CSP headers, and non-mocked verification.
conflictNote: Server validates all inputs and enforces resource-level authz; never ships stack traces or unverified mock passes.
